-- v8 7 (build review 1 M1 + review 2 MUST 1): the phone text floor on phone-sized windows (308 px = 844 x 390 with the
-- 58 px top bar, 299 px = the iPhone 17 Pro emulator, 330 px = a 36 px bar), on PC
-- every shown phone label keeps >= 3 px between its text (outline included) and its box (a chip's text >= 1 px from
-- its icon), the CLAIM labels also above / below their letters, the CLAIM ALL count badge clear of the letters
local function v8clear(pp)
	local bad, worst, n = {}, math.huge, 0
	for _, row in pp.PhoneClear:Invoke() do
		if row.badgeGap then
			if row.badgeGap < 0 then table.insert(bad, ("badge %.1f"):format(row.badgeGap)) end
		elseif not row.keep then
			n += 1
			for side, need in {left = row.gapL or 3, right = 3, top = 3, bottom = 3} do
				local v = row[side]
				if v then
					worst = math.min(worst, v - need)
					if v < need - 0.05 then table.insert(bad, ("%s %s %.1f"):format(row.path, side, v)) end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return bad, worst, n
end
